scope: SPU presets and other project text use the shared Code editor.

behavior.selection: Select a valid preset JSON to apply its sound and open Code. Other text opens without applying an instrument.
behavior.editing: Text edits autosave to Files; select a valid sound JSON again to apply changes. Run/Apply/shortcuts never execute text.
behavior.saveSound: Write a collision-safe named preset; prepare its Code path without changing Keyboard/Code mode, focus or an active performance.
behavior.ownership: Keep actual executing JS path separate from displayed JSON for Stop, rename/delete/import. Cancel stale Run preparation at file-selection intent, including initial editor setup.
behavior.limits: JavaScript retains its existing 2 MiB character bound. Non-JS text uses the 16 MiB project byte budget; rejected edits or JS renames keep existing files.
behavior.monaco: For mixed JS/text hosts only, disable optional word-occurrence highlighting at initialization. This avoids Monaco 0.52.2 WordHighlighter Delayer cancellation rejections on rapid model changes. Completion, hover, definitions and readable implementation remain available; FM/SID defaults are unchanged.
